-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      # name is a string-valued property.
      name: 3

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name.Value: cannot parse.*as string: using string value.*

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      name:
        definition:
          label: Name
          value_type: string
        values:
          - value: StringValue{"3"}
